This happens when $i$ ranges from $0$ to $j-1$. In $a_i$, $b_j$ occupies the position corresponding to $7^{j-1}$.

    """
    digits = b

    for i in range(L):
        n += digits[i] * (7**i)

    # Calculate S = sum(a_i)

        # Digits remaining: b_m ... b_{k+1} followed by b_{k-1} ... b_0
        remaining_digits = []

                remaining_digits.append(digits[i])
